intro: Cocoa is the main export of São Tomé and Príncipe.

chapters.title: Cocoa
text: High-quality cocoa, coffee and palm oil are grown. Tourism to its beaches and forests is growing.

chapters.title: Aid
text: The economy relies heavily on foreign aid.

keyTerms.meaning: The bean used to make chocolate.
